title: Zeinosides A–D: pregnane glycosides from Caralluma adenensis
content:

Ola E. Abdel-Sattar, Manal M. Sabry, Riham A. El-Shiekh, Ali M. El-Halawany, Othman S. S. Al-Hawshabi, Mustafa Abdullah Yilmaz, Ali Riza Tufekci, Meselhy R. Meselhy, Essam Abdel-Sattar
Four undescribed pregnane glycosides, zeinosides A–D (1–4), were isolated from the methanolic extract of Caralluma adenensis. The structures of these compounds were elucidated using comprehensive spectroscopic techniques.
